purpose: Teach: 閉塞/南方/先駆け/先取り/英訳/下宿/検知/絶叫

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、道路の閉塞、つまり閉塞による交通事故を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So this case — the traffic accident caused by the road being blocked — you'll be investigating that, won't you.
lines.style: Thinking aloud, careful and deferential, checking his understanding with a polite rise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、南方からの密航事案も対応されますね
lines.en: The force also handles smuggling cases coming up from the south.
lines.style: Even professional cadence, matter-of-fact, a quiet steadiness born of routine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、捜査の先駆け、つまり先駆け捜査官の経験を、警察、活かされますね
lines.en: And for this case, you'll be drawing on the experience of the pioneering investigators — the ones who led the way — won't you.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly bookish phrasing, leaning into the question at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯人の動向を先取り、つまり先取り捜査されますね
lines.en: We anticipate the suspect's movements — preemptive investigation, staying one step ahead.
lines.style: Calm and assured, a measured beat before the key term, no drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、英訳された海外文書を、警察、慎重に取り扱われますね
lines.en: And the English-translated documents from overseas — those get handled very carefully, don't they.
lines.style: Respectful and precise, slowing over the detail to show he's been listening.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、下宿で起きた事案を、警察、丁寧に対応されますね
lines.en: Incidents at lodging houses — the force responds to those with real care as well.
lines.style: A warmer note entering the professional tone, unhurried, quietly reassuring by the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、薬物検知器、つまり検知装置を、警察、ご利用されますね
lines.en: And for this case, you'll be using the drug detectors — the detection equipment — won't you.
lines.style: Bright with interest in the equipment, the question rising politely, almost gesturing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の絶叫の通報も、警察、迅速に対応されますね
lines.en: And when a call reports a victim screaming, we respond immediately — no delay.
lines.style: Firm closing assurance, tempo picking up slightly, ending on solid quiet conviction.
